app.name: Anaklo
app.tagline: Not just an appointment book. It remembers every client.

landing.body: Appointments and a smart client book for barbershops, hair salons and beauty centres.

booking.notFoundBody: Check the link or ask the business for it.
booking.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

pro.todayPlaceholder: Here you will see today's appointments, the gaps and which clients are overdue.
pro.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email. We will send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSentNeutral: If this email has an account, we have sent you a code.
login.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
login.errorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorCodeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again or ask for a new code.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account does not belong to any business. Ask the owner to add you, or sign in with a different email.

install.title: Add to your Home Screen first
install.intro: Anaklo works as an app on your Home Screen. That is where you sign in and get notifications.
install.stepShare: Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.stepOpen: Open Anaklo from your Home Screen and sign in there.
install.note: Signing in here, in the browser, does not carry over to the app.

push.title: Notifications (test)
push.statusOff: Notifications are off on this device.
push.statusOn: Notifications are on on this device.
push.statusDenied: Notifications are blocked. Change this in the device settings.
push.statusUnsupported: This device or browser does not support notifications.
push.statusNeedsInstall: Add the app to your Home Screen first.
push.statusFailed: Notifications did not load. Try again later.
push.testFailed: The test notification was not sent. Try again.

spike.title: Trusted device test
spike.trusted: Trusted device: the cookie was read.
spike.issued: A new cookie was just written. Close the app, open it again and check again.
spike.none: There is no cookie on this device.
